verdict.rationale: The evidence shows MX aggregating accounts and up to 24 months of transaction history, plus generic "data-driven intelligence" and personalized guidance claims. Nothing documents recurring-stream detection, payroll detection, cash-flow signals, or an income verification product. Raw transaction retrieval is only a building block a developer could use to derive such signals, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform derives income and cash-flow signals from connected accounts — recurring streams, payroll detection, or documented income verification products built on the same data
